sloka: तावत्सर्वाणि दत्तानि क्रतुमध्ये महात्मनः ।विविधानि च गौडानि खाण्डवानि तथैव च ।। ७.९२.११ ॥
transliteration: tāvatsarvāṇi dattāni kratumadhye mahātmanaḥ ।vividhāni ca gauḍāni khāṇḍavāni tathaiva ca ।। 7.92.11 ॥

translations.english: In the midst of the great-souled one's sacrifice, all sorts of things were given, including various jaggery sweets and sugar sweets.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि हे देवगण ! मेरे ही अपचार से उस ब्राह्मण का बह इकलौता पुत्र असमय मरा है
